results.snippet:
c_sample - Country/Sample ISO 3166 Code (see country for codes for whole nation states)Country/ Sample (see the variable 'country' for codes for whole nation states).  

To indicate the subsamples within the ISSP countries a code on the basis of ISO 3166 was constructed. For all countries without subsamples the three digit ISO 3166 Code (as in the variable 'country') was used.  

For those with subsamples a five digit numeric code is used. The first three-digits are based on the original ISO code and indicate the country. The following two- digit numeric appendices (01, 02) indicate the subsamples.
...
528 NL- Netherlands
